label: Dragon Hoard
description: Inside the wyrm's vault: an interior lit by one flame reflected in ten thousand golden surfaces — stealth, parley or wrath via variants.
prefix: Deep inside a dragon's hoard — a treasure-vault interior where nearly all light arrives as reflection, one small flame multiplied across coin, gold and gem. The dragon is the landscape; the intruder gives it scale.
suffix: Hoard Rendering: (treasure-light — every lit surface fed by reflected gold, warm bounce stacked on warm bounce, darkness winning wherever the metal ends:1.25), (one believable flame as the sole light origin, gem-fire and coin-glints all agreeing on its direction:1.2), fine dust igniting to bright points where it drifts through the beam, painted in baroque hoard-tenebrism, the vault's true size told by how little of it the light can claim.
negative: daylight, flat even lighting, electric light, modern objects, watermark, text, child, underage
